Name: Ugly cyberpunk stable
Author: Brokendrill
Description:
这是马廊的美化，改成了刺眼的扭蛋机，加上了一点点的黑暗感。我很努力想画出赛博朋克的感觉了，但是我的技术有限，所以画出来丑丑的...而且因为颜色的原因在游戏里非常突兀，也许我之后画个全套建筑就不会那么突兀了(Ｔ▽Ｔ)。
使用方法:下载文件解压后放入文件夹内的Stardew valley/mods，之后去找罗宾建造马廊就行了，不想用了删除就可以，不会影响游戏。
The following is from translation software:
This is the beautification of the horse gallery, which has been changed into a dazzling egg twisting machine. I tried very hard to draw the feeling of Cyberpunk, but my skills are limited, so it is ugly ... and it is very abrupt in the game because of the color. Maybe I will draw a complete set of buildings later, which will not be so abrupt.。
How to use: After downloading, put the file in Stardew valley/mods，Then go to Robin's place to build a horse gallery and you can see it.
